plugin.meaning: The plugin has not been approved yet, so it is off at the deployment.
A superuser approved the plugin, and organizations may enable it.
The kill switch. The plugin leaves every user's list at its next refresh, and the API refuses its proxy and backend calls at once. Restoring the plugin undoes it.

version.meaning: The scan found and checked the version, but nobody has approved it.
This is the one version that serves users.
A check failed, or the files changed after discovery. Versions are immutable, so the deployer has to publish a new version.
The version was active once, and it can be approved again.
The version's directory is gone. When every version of a plugin is missing, a superuser can forget the plugin, which deletes its reviews, grants, settings and secrets.
